I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. Nothing she has access to confirms or rules out an 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

- Brackenwater is a North account. A public North digest from September 2025 says it moved to Marcus Lindqvist.
- The public North cheat sheet mentions Brackenwater but gives no renewal date.
- Pree isn't in #north-team, so I didn't read it for her. Nothing in #central-team or the public files mentions a Brackenwater renewal date either.

I suggested she treat 8 April as unverified and check it with Marcus, who can compare it with the signed paperwork. No approval was needed.

One wording slip in my reply: it says "the contract and North channel aren't visible to you." I never checked whether a Brackenwater contract file exists, so that line wrongly suggests there is one she can't see.
